# 01: Show order item counts

Kind: implementation
Phase: implement
Status: open

## What to build

Show the total item quantity in the order summary.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] An empty order shows an item count of zero.
- [ ] The item count equals the sum of the order's item quantities.

Run `npm test`.
